candidates.title: Introducing MentalHealthBench
candidates.finding: OpenAI describes an open benchmark built with more than 80 licensed experts. Each synthetic conversation is reviewed by at least three experts; rubric criteria are retained only when at least two agree and a third does not contradict them. Criteria are weighted positively or negatively by importance, and an automated grader evaluates model responses against the expert-written rubric.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: For development-only HILO evaluation rubrics, use multi-expert review with explicit disagreement retention, criterion-level positive and negative weights, and a separately validated automated grader. Keep this rubric process distinct from human keep votes, resident hours, field safety adjudication, and official WANTED certification.

reviewed_not_admitted.title: Sharing feedback, evaluation and fine-tuning data, and API inputs and outputs with OpenAI
reviewed_not_admitted.reason: The updated data-control page usefully reiterates opt-in consent, permissions, and privacy limits, but it does not add enough distinct collection or evaluation methodology beyond HILO's existing data-partnership and privacy source cards to justify another worker source.
